run_power_iteration: run the power method on a square matrix to estimate its largest singular value
run_svd_penalty: run an SVD-based penalty on a PyTorch model to regularize its largest singular values
test_power_iteration: test the power_iteration function with a random square matrix and verify the returned norm estimate
test_svd_penalty: test the svd_penalty function on a PyTorch model with exact SVD mode enabled for validation
refactor_svd_penalty: refactor the svd_penalty function to support additional layer types beyond Conv and LSTM
